reason: The idea is useful, since I already chase late and short supplier acknowledgements by hand every day. But I would not pay $2,000 a month to a company that may not exist next year, and I would have to explain that to my plant manager and controller.
objection: A pre-MVP startup might not be around next year, and then I am stuck with a tool my ERP partner cannot support.
would_change_my_mind: A paying customer I can call as a reference, or a signed commitment with data export and a refund if they fold, plus proof the alerts catch things my buyers miss.
